note: G34: Length-1 rules and constant grounding on FB15k-237 test split

controls.name: C1_planted_composition_upper_bound
controls.must_fire_because: a rule engine with valid inference must achieve MRR=1.0 on a planted composition
controls.can_fail_because: inference walk could miss multi-hop paths or fail filter verification
controls.null_must_contain: an unpredicted or incorrectly ranked query on a deterministic planted relation

controls.name: C2_empty_rule_lower_bound
controls.must_fire_because: an empty rule set must yield zero hits and MRR near random entity expectation
controls.can_fail_because: tie-breaking bug could assign rank 1 to unpredicted entities
controls.null_must_contain: non-zero hits when zero rules are provided

controls.name: C3_metric_monotonicity
controls.must_fire_because: Hits@1 <= Hits@3 <= Hits@10 must strictly hold across all models
controls.can_fail_because: metric calculation bug across different thresholds
controls.null_must_contain: a strict violation of Hits@K monotonicity

controls.name: C4_strict_additivity
controls.must_fire_because: combined rule system must strictly exceed individual sub-models on Filtered MRR
controls.can_fail_because: rule conflict or confidence calibration degradation
controls.null_must_contain: combined system scoring lower MRR than 2-hop baseline

falsifiers.name: F1_length1_lift
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Length-1 rules fail to add at least +0.03 Filtered MRR over pure 2-hop rules
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a marginal or zero MRR gain from length-1 rules
falsifiers.refutes: Length-1 inverse and subsumption rules provide substantial link prediction gains over 2-hop rules
falsifiers.fires_when: Length-1 rules fail to add at least +0.03 Filtered MRR over pure 2-hop rules
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_constants_lift
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Constant grounding fails to improve Filtered MRR by at least +25% over (G17+L1)
falsifiers.refutes: Constant-grounded rules provide substantial link prediction gains over variable-only rules
falsifiers.fires_when: Constant grounding fails to improve Filtered MRR by at least +25% over (G17+L1)
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_literature_parity
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Full G34 rule engine fails to achieve Filtered MRR >= 0.1980 on FB15k-237
falsifiers.refutes: Kingfisher rule engine reaches benchmark parity with standard length<=2 rule baselines (AMIE+)
falsifiers.fires_when: Full G34 rule engine fails to achieve Filtered MRR >= 0.1980 on FB15k-237
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: Length-1 rules fail to add +0.03 MRR, constant grounding fails +25% lift, or full system fails AMIE+ parity (0.1980 MRR)
